title: Ɔbotan a Ɛnyɛ Den no Sɔhwɛ
intro: Mpɔtam bi a wɔn ho akokwaw na wɔyɛ ahantan no dii wɔn agyapade no guu mmepɔw no so ankasa. Nanso bere a wɔde sɛnkyerɛnne a emu da hɔ kɔmaa wɔn, gyidi ne ahosodi ho sɔhwɛ no, wɔn ahantan no de wɔn faa ɔkwan a wɔrensan nkɔ so. So wubetumi ahu kuw yi ne nea efi wɔn asɔretia no mu ba?
clues: Ná yɛyɛ abo wuranom, na yedi adwini a ɛyɛ nwonwa kɔ mmepɔw no nkyɛn tẽẽ.
Ɔbɔfo bi a ofi yɛn ankasa nkurɔfo mu baa yɛn nkyɛn, frɛɛ yɛn sɛ yɛnsom Nokware Nyankopɔn Baako no.
Yɛhwehwɛɛ sɛnkyerɛnne bi a ɛbɛkyerɛ sɛ ne nsɛm no yɛ nokware, na wɔde abɔde soronko bi bae sɛ sɔhwɛ maa yɛn.
Wɔmaa yɛn ahyɛde tiawa bi: sɛ yɛne abɔde yi nkyɛ yɛn nsu fibea, na yɛmma nom da a wɔahyɛ no.
Wɔ yɛn ahantan mu no, yɛn mu kakraa bi bɔɔ pɔw na yɛbuu kɔkɔbɔ no so, na yɛbɔɔ abɔde a na wɔahyɛ da ayɛ yɛn sɛnkyerɛnne no.
Wɔmaa yɛn nnansa ansa na yɛn ɔsɛe reba, na afei ɔtopae a ano yɛ den bi gyee yɛn wɔ yɛn afie mu, na ɛmaa yɛn nkwa nni hɔ na yɛdanee.

trial.label: Dɛn ne Yɛn Sɔhwɛ Titiriw?
options: Adaka a wɔresi na ama wɔanya nkwa wɔ nsuyiri mu
Ɔsɔretia a wɔsɔre tia ɔpɛ a ɛne sɛ wobeyi mpataa Homeda no
Adwumayɛ mu nneyɛe a ɛyɛ nnaadaa a wobegyae
Yoma a ɔyɛ anwonwade a ɔbɔ ho ban
Mfe ason ɔkɔm a wogyinaa ano
trial.answer: Yoma a ɔyɛ anwonwade a ɔbɔ ho ban

location.label: Dɛn ne Ade titiriw a Ɛwɔ Yɛn Asɛm no Mu?

outcome.label: Dɛn ne Yɛn Nkrabea a Etwa To?
options: Mframa a ano yɛ den a ɛbɔe no ahyɛ no so
Wɔde abura bi a ɛpaee apete
Wɔsɛee no denam ɔtopae/asasewosow a ano yɛ den so
outcome.answer: Wɔsɛee no denam ɔtopae/asasewosow a ano yɛ den so

arabic: فَعَقَرُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰصَـٰلِحُ ٱئْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: So they hamstrung the she-camel and were insolent toward the command of their Lord and said, "O Ṣāliḥ, bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the messengers." (7:77)
